en.headline: Thousands join Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge half marathon with Platinum Label status
en.dek: The event on Sunday drew a record number of runners and featured a new 10km category, with Ethiopian athletes taking the overall titles.
body: Tens of thousands of runners took part in the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong Section Half Marathon on Sunday morning, the organisers said.

The race, organised by the Hong Kong, China Association of Athletics Affiliates, has been upgraded to World Athletics Platinum Label status, the highest tier for international road races. It is the first time Hong Kong has hosted a competition at this level and only the fourth half marathon worldwide to receive the designation this year.

The event included half-marathon, 10-kilometre and open categories, with a total quota of 10,000 places. Secretary for Justice Paul Lam took part in a shorter honorary run and said Hong Kong should host more major sporting events to showcase the city's strengths.

Ethiopian runner Addisu Gobena won the men's half marathon in a course-record time of 1 hour 1 minute 36 seconds. His compatriot Wede Kefale took the women's title in 1 hour 9 minutes 1 second. Local runners Cheung Yiu-leung and Lo Ying-chiu finished first among Hong Kong athletes in the men's and women's half-marathon categories respectively.

zh.headline: 港珠澳大橋半馬吸引數千跑手 賽事獲白金標籤認證
zh.dek: 周日舉行的港珠澳大橋（香港段）半馬拉松錄得破紀錄參加人數，並新增十公里組別，埃塞俄比亞選手奪得總冠軍。
body: 中國香港田徑總會主辦的港珠澳大橋（香港段）半馬拉松周日早上舉行，吸引數以千計跑手參與。
今年賽事升格為世界田徑聯會白金標籤道路賽事，屬國際公路賽最高級別，是香港首次舉辦此級別賽事，亦是全球第四個獲此認證的半馬拉松。
賽事設半馬拉松、十公里及公開組別，總名額一萬人。律政司司長林定國參與較短的榮譽跑，並表示希望香港能舉辦更多大型體育賽事，展示城市實力。
埃塞俄比亞跑手高賓拿以1小時1分36秒刷新賽事紀錄勝出男子半馬，同鄉姬法莉以1小時9分1秒奪得女子冠軍。本地跑手張耀樑及羅映潮分別成為男女半馬本地第一。
